rules.TRIVIAL: Purely mechanical, text/UI/value/typo or equivalent low-risk single-point change.
rules.SMALL: Small logic/behavior change with no architecture decision.
rules.NORMAL: New feature or multi-layer change within existing architecture.
rules.COMPLEX: Cross-system or architecture-significant change requiring technical planning.

task_kinds.UI: Visual/layout/styling/copy change in the presentation layer only: widgets, screens, styles, paddings, colors, texts, icons, animations. No business logic, no data layer, no API contract change.
task_kinds.LOGIC: Business logic, data, network, storage, state management or build configuration change.
task_kinds.MIXED: Both a UI change and a logic change in the same task.
